summary: require the stage replay for a check change
pull_request_body: The plan changes a check of the stage job and holds no task that runs the replay with the score before and after the change. The case records the plan before the check of #3331 exists.
why: Issue #3331: plans that change the stage prompt or a stage gate reach implementation without the eval replay task.
what_changes: Add the tests of the rule to `tests/roadmap/test_roadmap_stage_form.py`.
feasibility: `check_proposal` of `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py` runs in the stage job and in the replay, so one rule judges both.
existing_tool: The change extends `check_proposal`, which the stage job and the replay already call, so no second check appears.

decisions.reason: The stage job and the replay both call it, so one code path gives one answer.

rejected.evidence: The stage job calls `check_proposal` and does not call `run_gates`, so a new gate alone would not refuse a plan.

added.name: A plan that changes a stage check runs the replay
added.text: The stage job SHALL refuse a plan that changes the stage prompt or a check of the stage job unless one group task runs `uv run devops roadmap eval stage --replay` and states the score before and after the change.

scenarios.name: A check change with no replay task
scenarios.when: A plan changes `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py` and no group task runs the replay with the score before and after the change.
scenarios.then: `check_proposal` returns a problem that names the changed path and the replay command.

groups.title: Refuse a check change without the replay
groups.test: a plan that changes a check with no replay task is refused
groups.verify: uv run devops ci test tests/roadmap/test_roadmap_stage_form.py
